children: Overview
Canada wound care developer's Q3 2026 revenue rose sharply yr/yr, driven by revyve product sales
Company posted positive gross profit for Q3, compared to a gross loss a year ago
Net loss widened in Q3, with higher operating expenses offset by increased government assistance
Outlook
Company plans to initiate biocompatibility testing for DispersinB Hydrogel in Q4 2026
Clinical trials and case series for revyve are underway or pending approval at multiple North American sites
Result Drivers
REVYVE SALES - Q3 revenue growth was driven by sales of the revyve product line, with most sales coming from five new customers
DISTRIBUTION EXPANSION - Co focused on expanding its distributor network in Canada and the U.S. to support revyve growth
GROSS PROFIT - Gross profit in Q3 was generated from sales of the revyve product line
